title.narrative: UC-IUC 2023 (Phase out) - Institutional University Cooperation with Mountains of the Moon University (MMU)

description.narrative: UG2023IUC027A103 01/09/2023 - 31/08/2025 The IUC Partner Programme at Mountains of the Moon University enters into phase out period to consolidate sustainability of achieved results. Phase out period will constitute 2 years. In the first year (year 11), a big closing event is planned. This will involve a scientific conference, an Agriculture, Tourism and Environment Expo 2024 and associated activities. Dissemination, project proposal writing and finalisation of PhDs will be implemented. There will be an end of programme evaluation and the start of closing administrative as well as financial accounts and associated in Year 11 that will spill over to Year 12.
